title: Silver Plus Saver Account: Transferring funds to external banks
summary: Explains how to transfer funds from a Silver Plus Saver Account to external banks: standard external (ACH) transfers complete in 2 business days after submission to any verified linked account, while domestic wire transfers are for priority and cost a $15 outgoing fee. Covers step-by-step transfer process, status tracking, and troubleshooting for delays/returns using a transfer reference.
faqs: How long do standard external (ACH) transfers from my Silver Plus Saver account take?
